founded_detail: Established by Royal Decree in 1401 AH (1981 AD), converting Haradh Agricultural and Animal Production Company into the National Agricultural Development Company. First agricultural joint-stock company in the Saudi capital market.
initial_capital_note: 400 million Saudi riyals at founding, per /en/about
major_shareholder: SALIC (Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company)
mission: Providing products with beneficial nutritional value and exceptional quality that meet the needs and aspirations of customers and beneficiaries.
vision: Deliver products with high nutritional value to achieve regional and global leadership in the food industry sector, contributing to food security aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.

strategic_framework.name: 2023-2027 Strategy
strategic_framework.goals: Developing sustainable agricultural projects, investing in new food sectors, expanding into new markets, supporting Saudi Vision 2030 food security objectives.
strategic_framework.related_program: New Dawn strategy - transforming NADEC into an integrated food producer with sustainable food security focus
